text: Faster CPU/GPU performance speeds up building and testing apps across multiple Xcode simulators
quote: This huge boost in performance makes building and testing apps across multiple simulators in Xcode quicker than ever.

text: Supports Thunderbolt 5 with up to 120Gb/s data transfer, over double Thunderbolt 4 throughput
quote: M4 Pro also supports Thunderbolt 5 on Mac, delivering up to 120Gb/s data transfer speeds, which more than doubles the throughput of Thunderbolt 4.

text: Delivers high performance with strong power efficiency for large AI, video, and code workloads
quote: For professionals working on larger file sizes across AI, video, code bases, and more, M4 Pro offers stunning performance and Apple silicon’s legendary power efficiency.

text: Improved hardware-accelerated ray tracing in the GPU boosts game visuals and speeds up 3D rendering
quote: with the improved hardware-accelerated ray-tracing engine in the M4 family GPU, games like Control look more compelling, and pro 3D renderers can produce stunning imagery in even less time.

text: Faster Neural Engine runs on-device Apple Intelligence models at high speed
quote: This, combined with the faster Neural Engine of the M4 family, means on-device Apple Intelligence models run at blazing speed.

text: Metal API exposes advanced GPU capabilities to developers
quote: Metal puts the advanced capabilities of Apple-designed GPUs at your fingertips.

text: Metal debugger lets developers inspect and optimize the rendering pipeline including ray tracing and ML
quote: Inspect, debug, and optimize your entire rendering pipeline with Metal debugger — from mesh shading to ray tracing and machine learning.

text: PyTorch backend support accelerates ML model training directly on the Mac
quote: Accelerate the training of machine learning models in third-party frameworks right on your Mac with PyTorch backends.

text: MLX open-source array framework supports training, research, and fine-tuning of generative models on Apple Silicon
quote: MLX is an open-source array framework that lets you experiment with, training, researching, and fine-tuning generative models on Apple Silicon.

text: Core ML provides fast on-device integration of traditional ML models like tree ensembles and regression
quote: Core ML delivers fast performance for integrating traditional machine learning models into your apps and games — from tree ensembles to regression models and beyond.
